2609.19113.title: Playing log(N)-Questions over Wikipedia Abstracts: Communication Efficiency Between Paired Frontier Models
2609.19113.paper_summary: We evaluate six frontier language models on the two-agent $\log(N)$-Questions game. A questioner sees $N$ Wikipedia lead paragraphs and must identify a secretly chosen target using exactly $\log_2 N$ yes/no questions. An answerer sees only the target and the question, and replies with one word. Both roles run on the same provider, so the game measures how well a model communicates with itself across an information asymmetry. We run 408 games over document sets of 4 to 1024 paragraphs at a total API cost of \$363. One model finishes well behind the others: Claude Opus 5 wins 28 of 68 games, against 45 to 56 for GLM-5.3, GPT-5.6 Sol, Grok 4.6, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Kimi K3. The leading five are only marginally separable. Pooling those five, win rate declines with set size at $r=-0.973$ and is fit by a single per-round reliability parameter. The form is $\text{win}=p^{\log_2 N}$ with $p=0.928$. Losses divide into answer errors and discrimination failures in roughly equal measure, and models almost never name a document their own evidence excludes. Every unanimous answer error from the weakest model was inspected: 32 of 34 are ``No'' answers, on properties stated in the document's first sentence, under an instruction that explicitly warns against defaulting to ``No''. Information per question, estimated from answer balance, correlates with win rate at $r=+0.88$. The only two models to extract a full bit per question are the only two that partition on document titles, a strategy absent below $N{=}32$ and used in a quarter of questions above it. Reasoning-token expenditure varies $4.5\times$ across models with little relation to success, and the trace grows as the candidate set shrinks without a matching gain in reliability.
2609.19113.paper_summary_zh: 我們在兩代理的 $\log(N)$-問題遊戲中評估六個前沿語言模型。提問者看到 $N$ 個維基百科的引言段落，必須使用恰好 $\log_2 N$ 個是/否問題來識別一個秘密選定的目標。回答者僅看到目標和問題，並用一個單詞回覆。兩個角色都在同一提供者上運行，因此該遊戲衡量模型在信息不對稱下的自我交流能力。我們在4到1024段落的文檔集上進行了408場比賽，總API成本為\$363。一個模型的表現遠遠落後於其他模型：Claude Opus 5贏得68場比賽中的28場，而GLM-5.3、GPT-5.6 Sol、Grok 4.6、Gemini 3.8 Flash和Kimi K3則贏得45到56場。前五名之間的區分僅僅是微弱的。將這五個模型合併，勝率隨著集合大小而下降，$r=-0.973$，並由一個每輪的可靠性參數擬合。其形式為 $\text{win}=p^{\log_2 N}$，其中 $p=0.928$。損失大致平均分為回答錯誤和識別失敗，模型幾乎從不將文件的證據排除在外。對最弱模型的每一個一致回答錯誤進行了檢查：34個中有32個是「否」的回答，針對文件第一句中所陳述的特性，並在明確警告不要默認為「否」的指示下。每個問題的信息量，從回答平衡中估算，與勝率的相關性為 $r=+0.88$。唯一兩個能夠每個問題提取完整位元的模型是唯一兩個在文檔標題上進行劃分的模型，這一策略在 $N{=}32$ 以下缺失，而在其以上的四分之一問題中使用。推理令牌的支出在模型之間變化達 $4.5\times$，與成功之間幾乎沒有關係，並且當候選集縮小時，追蹤增長而沒有相應的可靠性增益。
